description: Implementation of mDNS client logic, including socket handling, packet processing, cache management, and transaction handling for mDNS over IPv4/IPv6.

classes.name: MDnsConnection
classes.description: Manages UDP socket connections for mDNS, including socket creation, sending, receiving, and error handling.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for mDNS client, including socket management, packet parsing, cache management, and listener/transaction coordination.

classes.name: MDnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Represents a listener for mDNS records, handling record updates and refresh scheduling.

classes.name: MDnsTransactionImpl
classes.description: Handles mDNS query transactions, including cache queries, network queries, and callback invocation.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core
classes.description: Internal class managing cache, network communication, and listener/observer management.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::ListenerKey
classes.description: Key used for identifying listeners based on name and type.

methods.name: CreateSockets
methods.description: Creates and binds mDNS sockets for each network interface.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::SocketHandler::Start
methods.description: Initializes socket, retrieves local address, and joins mDNS group.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::SocketHandler::DoLoop
methods.description: Receives datagrams in a loop, processing incoming packets.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::SocketHandler::OnDatagramReceived
methods.description: Handles received datagram, continues loop or reports error.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::SocketHandler::Send
methods.description: Queues and sends datagram over socket.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::SocketHandler::SendDone
methods.description: Callback after send completes, processes queue.

methods.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::HandlePacket
methods.description: Parses incoming mDNS packet, updates cache, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::NotifyNsecRecord
methods.description: Handles NSEC records, updates cache, and alerts listeners for non-existent RR types.

methods.name: MDnsListenerImpl::ScheduleNextRefresh
methods.description: Schedules record refresh at 85% and 95% TTL intervals.

methods.name: MDnsTransactionImpl::Start
methods.description: Begins transaction, queries cache and/or network.

methods.name: MDnsTransactionImpl::TriggerCallback
methods.description: Invokes the user callback with the result.
